The transaction originated from a device profile marked as new for this account without proxy flagging, presenting an identity match status of zero. The customer maintains a robust history of 248 transactions totaling $49,409.28 across in-person and online channels, and is connected to card ID C01983-K1. Historical precedent in case CC-0539 indicates an identical transaction amount of $99.92 and a high risk score, which previously resulted in a cleared alert after cardholder confirmation of a new device. However, no customer response regarding the current activity is available on file. This activity is deemed suspicious due to the use of a new device profile for a card-not-present transaction.
